text: Researchers report that a meteorite found in the Sahara came from ancient Mars. Its minerals formed over four billion years ago.
Voyager One is saving power as its journey continues. Engineers have also resolved a brief interruption in communications with the spacecraft.
A Mars rover is studying dust on spacesuit samples. The findings could help researchers design better protection for future astronauts.
The Psyche spacecraft is heading toward the asteroid belt. Solar electric propulsion will power most of its remaining journey.
A new NASA study updates projections for Antarctica's Thwaites Glacier. Researchers are working to understand its contribution to future sea level rise.
Hubble and Webb have captured different views of the Cat's Head Nebula. Infrared images reveal stars hidden within its dusty clouds.
I left the notebook beside the window. We can pick it up later, when the room is quiet again.
Someone brought a small package this morning. It is waiting on the shelf outside, next to the spare keys.
